description: User delivers a prepared speech, pitch, or presentation to camera; AI records it and returns analysis on filler words, pacing, conciseness, word choice, eye contact, and body language. User can then enter Q&A mode where the AI asks follow-up questions about the material.

User specifies a role, company, and interviewer demeanor (or pastes a job description link); AI asks preset questions plus dynamic follow-ups based on the user's answers, then scores the responses. Supports multi-person panel interviews where different AI personas ask from different perspectives.

AI adopts a persona and roleplays a back-and-forth scenario in real time, adapting to the user's responses. Pre-built scenarios include sales calls, coaching calls, and difficult conversations with a manager; user can also personalize a custom conversation.

Targeted sales-conversation roleplays: inbound discovery (prospect made first contact; qualify and build trust), outbound discovery / cold call (create interest, engage a cold prospect), objection handling, and multi-persona buying-committee calls where several AI stakeholders each have distinct goals so the seller must read the room.

User authors their own roleplay by defining the AI persona, situation, objectives, and rubric; the AI then enacts it and scores against the custom criteria. Content Spaces let teams package custom scenarios and coachbots.
User records their speaking voice; AI analyzes pitch, pace, clarity, volume, and tonal qualities and returns a scored report with strengths and improvement areas, which seeds a personalized plan.
App generates a bite-sized daily training routine (5-10 min) tailored to the user's goal and ability, sequencing breathing, articulation, resonance, and pitch drills; tracks streaks and progress.

Watch-and-repeat breathing exercises to calm nerves and power the voice: 'Inner push' (diaphragm fundamentals), 'Hiss attack' (diaphragmatic breathing), 'Buzz charge' (diaphragm + resonators), 'Breath control' (breathing improvement and nerve calming).

Drills to deepen and enrich the voice by activating chest/head resonators and larynx positioning: 'Opera flow', 'Cosmic hmm' (larynx relaxation), 'Sound wave', 'Clear voice', 'Libra' (directing sound to front teeth), 'Sonor flow', 'Figure 8 sound' / pitch glides using the word 'SON' to even out vocal range.

Articulation exercises developing lip, tongue, and jaw musculature: 'Articulate!', 'Tongue flow', 'Jaw massage' (tension release), 'Wow workout' (articulation + facial expression). Plus a Tongue Twister Test where the user listens to a professionally recorded twister then records their own take for AI scoring on clarity and pacing.

Multi-week structured challenge courses, each a sequenced drill program toward a goal: Ultimate Challenge (overall voice/diction), Sexy/Sexy Voice Challenge (vocal appeal), Creators Challenge (YouTubers/podcasters/streamers), Accent Reduction Challenge, Voice Feminization Challenge, Voice Masculinization Challenge, Speech Recovery Challenge (post-stroke), Singers Basic Challenge.

Standalone diagnostic/playful tests that double as practice prompts: Archetype Test (find vocal strengths), Age Test, Celebrity Test (match voice to a celebrity), Accent Test, Spanish Accent Test (13 variants), Voice Rating Test, Speech Test, Singer Test.

Sequenced, unlockable bite-sized lessons (~5 min/day) that teach public-speaking techniques one at a time: storytelling, confidence, conciseness, pacing, filler-word reduction, energy, facial expression. App adjusts difficulty to skill level and suggests the next personalized lesson.

User speaks spontaneously on any topic, anytime; AI records and returns instant feedback on pace, filler words, energy, conciseness, clarity, confidence, pausing, and facial expression, with a transcript and metric graphs over time.
User rehearses a prepared/written speech; the app transcribes the delivery and compares it against the script, scoring delivery metrics so the user can polish a real presentation.
Themed speaking scenarios where the user practices a specific mode (storytelling, persuasive speaking, sales pitch, interview answers) and receives the same AI delivery feedback.
User flags their own personal filler words (beyond um/uh) for the AI to detect, then practices speeches aiming to reduce those specific crutch words; progress tracked over sessions.
Bite-sized (~2 min) daily vocal warm-up exercises to build muscle memory for an expressive, engaging voice; part of a 1,000+ exercise library with new content added regularly.
User records themselves speaking; AI gives real-time and post-session feedback on pace, tone, and filler words, plus analysis of storytelling flow and audience engagement.
User is given a randomly selected topic and speaks extemporaneously for ~2 minutes, then gets an immediate performance review; a dedicated impromptu-speaking section reviewers single out as valuable.
User is shown an image and must describe it aloud; AI gives feedback on spoken delivery and content quality.
User practices speaking about itemized/list-structured information aloud, receiving delivery feedback (newer feature).

AI roleplay mode for practicing real-life conversations out loud, from high-stakes moments to everyday small talk: job interviews, negotiations, networking, difficult conversations (feedback, leading meetings, conflict). User speaks and receives AI feedback after each scenario.

AI-recommended lesson courses across 100+ activities: storytelling, impromptu speaking, managing nerves, online presentations, business storytelling. Includes a toolkit of digital notecards and interview prompts.
Group sessions led by expert coaches in low-pressure settings, plus optional 1:1 coaching, including exclusive content from voice coach Roger Love.

Fast-paced game: the user is given rapid prompts (e.g. 'X is like Y because...') and must complete an analogy or sentence in ~5 seconds, before they can think. Trains speaking before you think, trusting the brain's 'autocomplete,' and killing overthinking/perfectionism. Adjustable difficulty up to 'INSANE/EXTREME' mode.

User narrates a continuous story while random distraction words appear on screen that they must weave in or ignore without losing their thread. Trains staying on topic under pressure, recovering from tangents, and not blanking when interrupted.

User speaks while a 'conductor' feeds a stream of random numbers 1-10 representing energy/intensity levels; they must instantly raise or lower their delivery energy to match each number (with periodic 'breathe' slides cueing a pause). Trains emotional range, conviction, energy control, and anxiety regulation.

Pausing game built on the metaphor that each word 'shakes up the snow globe' adding chaos, while pausing lets the snow settle and meaning emerge. User practices inserting deliberate strategic pauses into their speech. Trains pausing, pacing, and appearing thoughtful/confident.

Game/principle built on 'Choose One Thing': the user must distill a topic into a single core message and speak to land just that point, gathering supporting stories around it. Trains message clarity and focus.

Exercise framing a talk as a bow and arrow: the 'arrow' is the core message, the 'bow' (stories/experiences) is what makes it stick and fly. User figures out the one thing that matters most then assembles resonant stories around it. Trains persuasive structure and storytelling.
Game/principle ('End Strong') where the user practices landing a confident, deliberate ending rather than trailing off. Trains strong closes.

Game aimed at inducing a flow state where self-consciousness fades and connection with the audience becomes effortless; user speaks continuously to practice staying in flow. Trains spontaneity and presence.

Additional named games in the daily-training rotation. 'Own It' (commit fully to what you say / confidence), 'Breaking Character' (shift personas/styles mid-speech), and 'Pillars' (structure thoughts around key supporting points). Mechanics confirmed by name only; details inferred.

Live (Mon-Fri) 30-minute Zoom sessions where a coach leads the cohort through a series of the speaking games above with live feedback. Plus cohort courses (Fundamentals L1/L2, Professional L1, Creator Cohort) blending lessons + game practice + coaching.

User delivers a speech or presentation to a simulated VR audience (or on web) with configurable audience size, distractions, and venue; AI scores delivery (pace, filler words, eye contact) and an AI coach ('Hugh') gives feedback. Used within structured public-speaking courses.

AI roleplay interviews in web or VR with several variants: interview on uploaded resume + job description, recruiter-interviewing-candidate, panel interview (multi-avatar), general open-ended, higher-education, behavioral (STAR technique), and real company questions (Google, Facebook, DreamWorks). AI gives feedback and an AI coach debriefs.

50+ professional roleplay scenarios where the user converses with an AI avatar and gets feedback from AI coach Hugh. Categories: customer service, debating & negotiation, difficult conversations, sales pitching, networking, leadership. Available online and in VR in 15+ languages.
User/organization builds a custom roleplay scenario (persona, context, objectives) that the AI then enacts and scores, for bespoke practice beyond the library.

Self-paced courses combining video lessons with the above hands-on VR/AI practice exercises across public speaking, presentations, interviews, negotiation, sales, customer service, and leadership; completion yields a certificate. 55+ hands-on practice exercises total.

Library of 100-200+ real-world social challenges grouped by difficulty (easy -> medium -> extreme) for gradual desensitization. User completes one challenge at a time in real life and marks it done. Examples: ask a stranger for directions, request a discount, ask for a compliment, ask for a tour of the back of a store, ask for an employee discount, share your work publicly.

Gamified progress layer: daily challenge prompts, points, streaks, and badges to drive consistency, with daily progress tracking and accountability. User does one real-world challenge per day to keep the streak.
Users share their rejection experiences and outcomes with a supportive in-app community for encouragement and accountability; functions as social proof / debrief rather than a drill.
